purpose: Required-check semantics for CI (M-20) and the single source consumed VERBATIM by the owner-gated main branch-protection change (M-07). Contract-checked every run by scripts/check_required_checks.py: a renamed or removed job fails CI until this manifest is updated in the same change.

required_context_reasons.hygiene: Whitespace + public-quality audit (M-15/M-02) — blocking release hygiene.
required_context_reasons.feature-obligations: Fail-closed change classifier; unknown paths block before expensive jobs run.
required_context_reasons.governance: Integrity, CI/CD governance, test-harness governance, required-checks contract, release security readiness, security benchmark, PR change obligations. Read-only (M-13).
required_context_reasons.backend-format: ruff format --check in its own job so formatting can never hide the test suite (M-06/M-11).
required_context_reasons.backend-lint: Repo-wide correctness classes F821,F811,F822 blocking (M-03) + changed-file strict gate + governed-surface compile check. Style backlog stays advisory with a documented burn-down (M-24).
required_context_reasons.backend-test: Production rehearsal, harness/QA/property/governed-evolution contract tests, and the full backend suite.
required_context_reasons.frontend-mutation: Stryker gate — break 75 never lowered, related:false so no-coverage is honest (M-04/D.6); widened scope runs advisory-first.
required_context_reasons.test-harness-js: Relay unit tests, simulation static checks, real-user benchmark static checks.
required_context_reasons.qa-contract-render: QA compose profiles render (parse only — named honestly, M-05). Behavior-level QA contract tests live in backend-test.
required_context_reasons.ui-journeys: Container-first browser lane on the QA stack (loopback-only, synthetic data). Honest not_runnable handling: a missing capability fails the job with a named reason recorded in the evidence (D.8).
required_context_reasons.release-gate: Fail-closed aggregator: fails on failure, cancellation, or unexplained skip of any required context (D.1/D.9). Its needs list is contract-checked against this manifest.

desktop-check.reason: Desktop release status requires an explicit owner decision: (a) in scope — keep the system-lib install and add desktop-check to required_contexts here; or (b) out of scope — keep it excluded and state the exclusion in TESTING.md and the promotion dossier. The job runs and reports honestly either way; continue-on-error is not an acceptable release status, so the job has none.

notes: In-repo workflow changes and GitHub repository-setting changes are strictly separated (D.10): this manifest + docs/promotion/branch-protection/ PREPARE the protection change; only the owner applies it, then verifies by API read-back plus a negative mergeability test.
Job renames invalidate existing required contexts: keep old contexts until the replacements have been observed on GitHub, then update protection in one sequenced owner action.
Required contexts never depend on push-only or schedule-only paths (D.3): every context above is a job that runs on PR, push, schedule, and dispatch.
